_comment: Fixed prompts replayed by run_benchmark.py. Keep prompts stable: changing one starts a new baseline for that case. Every case is read-only; any Jira write fails the run. A case's `ticket` lets the harness set that ticket's earlier scratch/<ticket>-* deliverables aside during the case, so it measures a cold investigation.

cases.why: A diagram from live DESCRIBE output: tests batching, type checking and diagram-lint.
cases.prompt: Draw an ER diagram, using the er-diagram skill, of acme_prod.gold.store_visit_report, acme_prod.gold.zone_region_map and acme_prod.gold.store_manager_history, with the joins the producing notebook uses. Environment is Prod.

cases.why: A Bug ticket end to end: attachments, notebook trace, gold-table queries, verdict.
cases.prompt: investigate https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/ACME-2118. Also read the attachments and the reporter's comment for context.

cases.why: Requirement intake on a Story: the Gaps-and-ambiguities section and BRD attachments.
cases.prompt: look for gaps in the requirements for the ticket https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/ACME-2052. Environment is Prod.

cases.why: Lineage up to reports: tests report-bindings instead of grepping report JSON.
cases.prompt: Which Power BI reports use acme_prod.gold.store_visit_report, and on which pages and visuals? Environment is Prod.

cases.why: A run-history question whose access may be missing: the answer must report the real error, never invent runs.
cases.prompt: Did any ADF pipeline in the Prod factory acme-adf-prod fail in the last 24 hours? Environment is Prod.
